context: Ren and Mei recall a play they saw.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (劇場/開か/かける/ティー/肌) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あの劇場のお芝居、感動したね。
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle moved delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 幕が開かれた瞬間、鳥肌が立ったよ。
lines.en: The moment the curtain opened, I got goosebumps.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私も、肌で感動を覚えたの。
lines.en: I felt the emotion in my skin too.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いい席に、お金をかけて正解だったね。
lines.en: Spending on good seats was the right call.
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 次は、別の劇場にも行きたいな。
lines.en: Next I want to go to a different theater too.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 帰りに飲んだティー、おいしかったね。
lines.en: The tea we drank on the way back was good.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 幕が開かれるドキドキ、また味わいたい。
lines.en: I want to feel that curtain-rising thrill again.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 時間をかけて、また観に行こうよ。
lines.en: Let's take our time and go see one again.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
